title: Peekin AI: AI voice agents for B2B SaaS demos, onboarding & support | Product Hunt
excerpt: Peekin AI gives B2B SaaS teams two AI voice agents that share one memory across the customer journey. Demo Duck greets visitors 24/7, qualifies them, and books meetings on the spot. Guide Goose then uses that context to onboard new users and resolve support issues before they churn. Sub-second real-time voice, native CRM integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Attio+), full-funnel analytics, and built-in guardrails: one platform instead of separate demo, onboarding, and support tools.
